thesis.core: 2026H1 profit quality improved despite lower revenue: attributable profit and operating cash flow rose while sugar and tomato margins improved. The fundamental improvement is real, but the September price breakout has compressed the margin of safety and now requires unusually persistent commodity/margin conditions.
thesis.variant_wedge: The market is correctly detecting better unit economics, but two consecutive sharp up-days and a 9.03% gain on 9/9 have moved price faster than normalized earnings. This is a profitable cyclical operator, not a structurally high-multiple compounder.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Normalize 2026 EPS around RMB0.58 versus H1 EPS RMB0.2844, rather than annualizing the H1 margin expansion without a commodity-cycle haircut.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Base roughly annualizes H1 earnings with a modest H2 allowance; bull credits sustained sugar/tomato margin strength while bear reflects commodity normalization.

catalysts: Sugar/tomato gross margins remain above prior-year levels despite lower selling prices.
Operating cash flow remains positive and inventory discipline limits commodity-cycle cash absorption.
Domestic sugar supply/demand tightness supports processing and trading spreads.
kill_thesis: Sugar or tomato unit margins normalize sharply while the equity continues to price peak economics.
Inventory or hedging losses reverse the H1 cash-flow improvement.
Commodity prices and volumes weaken together, compressing both revenue and unit margin.

d2_answers.question: Is the breakout supported by fundamentals?
d2_answers.fact: 2026H1 revenue fell 21.16%, but attributable profit rose 36.75%, recurring profit rose 40.70% and operating cash flow rose 16.61%. Food-sugar gross margin was about 12.2% versus 7.48% a year earlier, while tomato gross margin was about 38.0% versus 16.97%.

d2_answers.question: Does valuation still offer attractive expected return?
d2_answers.fact: The stock closed RMB19.80 on 2026-09-09 after gains of about 10% and 9% on the prior two sessions.

d2_answers.question: Capital action?
d2_answers.judgment: AVOID new capital at the current price; reopen only after a major earnings upgrade or a price reset toward the low-teens / entry-hurdle area.
